integrity: A direct symbolic proof is accompanied by a standalone finite Rees-multiplication checker; finite tests are not universal proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only exponent two receives a complete classification for finite completely zero-simple semigroups; higher exponents receive a necessary condition only. The complete regularity construction does not classify arbitrary regular semigroups. Historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Two-complete mappings of completely zero-simple semigroups
